root_axes: metres, +Y up, +Z bow; origin calm water
capsizing: already baked; do not apply an additional pi rotation
adapter_required: Expose seat_anchor coordinates relative to the prop root as prop.seat; apply the prop/world transform only through actors.ride.
Use source floatStep once at the prop root; adjunct oar, rope and cloth move with the same root.
For sit use actor ride with heave/pitch/roll; for cling follow source horizontal pose without heave/tilt.
Do not use obsolete seat fallback (0.45,0.85,0).
The source floating prop is non-solid; delivered collision meshes are optional query/picking geometry, not a standing deck.
